linked_process_id.description: Identifier of the linked upstream or downstream process (do not modify).

analysis_status.description: Status of the AKTA chromatogram analysis.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were recorded to the database (UTC).

summary.description: Key metrics from AKTA chromatogram analysis.

num_peaks_detected.description: Number of peaks detected in the UV chromatogram.

retention_times_min.description: List of peak retention times in minutes.

peak_heights_mau.description: List of peak heights in milli-absorbance units (mAU).

akta_data_source.description: Source of AKTA data used for analysis (server_json, local_json, local_csv, or unknown).

files_processed.description: Number of AKTA data files successfully processed.

data_files.description: Paths or names of analysis data output files.

analysis_results_json.description: Path to the full analysis results JSON file.

timeseries_csv.description: Path to the processed time-series CSV file.

peaks_csv.description: Path to the detected peaks CSV file (if peaks were found).

plots.description: Paths or names of plot files generated by the analysis.

chromatogram_png.description: Path to the chromatogram PNG plot.

chromatogram_pdf.description: Path to the chromatogram PDF plot.

analysis_metadata.description: Raw metadata block taken from the analysis_results JSON (excluding file paths).
